notes.title: Grapple Car Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Huge thanks to everyone that has played the demo so far! I'm so happy to hear you are having fun with my game :)[/b]
[/h3][p][i]This patch includes a few community requested features, bug-fixes, and general quality of life improvements.[/i] [/p][p][/p][h1][b]PATCH NOTES:[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b][i]CHANGES:[/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved grapple steering consistency[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled right thumb stick click to look behind[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial level set-dressing and added some details[/p][/*][*][p]Add start/finish line decal for better clarity of where laps start[/p][/*][*][p]Added quick restart button[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller rumble, along with an option to disable it in the options for those of you who are not fans[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bug report button to the main menu for you to... uh... report bugs[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b][i]BUG-FIXES:[/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug that happened if you paused as you go in the water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few UI bugs where it showed the wrong amount of car points[/p][/*][*][p]It is no longer possible to submit a lap-time if you haven't finished a full lap (should fix the bottom of the leaderboard being filled with a bunch of 999999 scores)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a couple of PT-BR translation errors[/p][/*][/list]
